findings.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
findings.description: InsecureSkipVerify is set, so any man-in-the-middle with a self-signed certificate is trusted for outbound calls to the payment processor.

findings.title: Hardcoded API credential
findings.description: A live-looking secret key is committed to source control. Anyone with repository read access can charge the merchant account.

findings.title: Integer overflow in amount calculation
findings.description: Amounts are converted from int64 to int32 before being summed, so a large batch wraps negative and can credit a customer.

findings.title: Weak randomness for transaction reference
findings.description: math/rand is used to generate an order reference, which is predictable and therefore guessable by an attacker.

findings.title: Vulnerable dependency: requests 2.25.1 (CVE-2023-32681)
findings.description: requests before 2.31.0 leaks Proxy-Authorization headers to a destination that has been redirected to, on the same host as the proxy.
